## Findings and refutations
1. validate-sdrf exit 0 for both files; one WARNING each: 'fetal stage' not in EFO. The value is HsapDv:0000037 'fetal stage'
   (verified in OLS), taken from Cellosaurus CVCL_0063 'AG Fetus'; same value and warning as the curated precedent PXD023136
   (HEK293T, same lab). Not an error.
2. reconcile exit 0 for both, one MINOR cleavage_agent_unsupported each: the PRIDE record does not name the digestion enzyme.
   Refuted with the search output: both MaxQuant summary.txt files (combined.zip, combined-AP-MS.zip) give Enzyme 'Trypsin/P',
   mode Specific, for every searched file; trypsin is written per batch rule 2. Recorded as a limitation (the whole-cell
   protocol cites Kulak et al., which may add Lys-C; not asserted).
3. convert-openms exit 0 for both (SUCCESS); the warning 'no TA= specified' comes from the Acetyl PP=Protein N-term modification
   and is expected.
4. structure, check, schema-check, manifest-coverage: exit 0 for both in round 2.

# Fixes after review (tables/scripts only, then rebuild with build.sh; no post-build edit):
#  knockout: O-168..170 partners -> 'HEK293T expressing yeast ACP1' (own level), KO -> 'NDUFAB1 knockout; yeast ACP1 expressing'
#            (P32463 intensities in both channels, Supp Table 1 ACP1-1/-3, Supp S2 'HEK293TACP1');
#            factor value[cellular component] added (mitochondrion / whole cell); biological replicates renumbered per
#            (genotype, cellular component) group; comment[sample preparation batch] marks COA6 T1-T3 (MB307, Mar 2014) vs
#            T4-T5 (separate 8 M urea preparation, MB531, Sep 2014), 'not available' elsewhere;
#            characteristics[sample storage temperature] = not available (cell-lines recommended column).
#  apms:     NDUFAB1-FLAG control runs 25-27 -> 'HEK293T expressing yeast ACP1' (Supp S2 header); factor value[detergent]
#            added; biological replicates renumbered per (genotype, detergent) group (1-3).
#  manifests: channel claim records the V-227 / T-215 acquisition-tag conflicts (data support the deposited tags) and
#            121/121 agreeing experiments; control numbering called an upper bound; COA6 claim corrected; precursor note
#            (all 51 >4.5 ppm evidences are MULTI-MATCH); sample-prep heterogeneity limitation. BLOCKED.md section updated
#            in place with the O-173 acquisition-name / data conflict.
